structural_change: RXC split (S-ELEM-C 10-15): the CLOSED g4 control (dsfd_su_t_rxc, 11,566 sinks on one root over 280.8 x 367.2) failed the native pin audit (R 368.1 / spread 67.2 ps, launch 265.5 > 220 on xq_x, capture 201.3 > 190 on 52 xa_r pins). It becomes one control leaf + four identical bit-slice leaves (slice s = 64-bit quarter s of both 256-bit halves of every row, so the QR coefficient select is slice-local), each leaf with its own replicated slot/row context (~40 FF) so no select crosses a leaf; 0 added cycles. Pins evenly spread per face (<= 0.55 of capacity), no output hold pads.
